summary: Defines a new object for RSVP-TE messages that carries extra attribute flags for MPLS label switched paths, since the eight-bit Flags field of the SESSION_ATTRIBUTE object was nearly used up. This is a Proposed Standard that obsoletes RFC 4420 and updates RFC 3209 and RFC 3473.

eli5.summary: A form with only eight tick boxes ran out of room. This memo adds a second page, so more options can be requested for a network path.
